items.title: Optimizely Supply Chain Attack Hits Major Crypto and Web Sites
points: Hackers compromised website testing platform Optimizely (a tool websites use to test different page variations) and injected malware across 178 client sites, including hardware wallet maker Ledger and the BBC
The malicious code replaced visitors' cryptocurrency wallet addresses with attackers' own addresses, letting them intercept crypto payments and card transactions
Shows how third-party software tools can become vectors for large-scale fraud affecting millions of users across unrelated websites

items.title: Trezor's Third Security Incident in Months Amid Shipping Partner Breaches
points: Shipping partner Skladon was breached, exposing names, addresses, and order details from roughly 27,000 Trezor customer orders
This is Trezor's third third-party security incident in three months, raising vendor risk management concerns
Some customers have already reported scam calls, indicating exposed personal data is being actively exploited

items.title: Bitcoin Mining Attack and Market Volatility
points: Luxor's CEO disclosed attackers used AI-enabled techniques to briefly redirect mining rewards (payments earned for validating Bitcoin transactions) from just over a dozen client accounts
Bitcoin fell to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July, as roughly $2 billion in crypto trading positions were liquidated over the weekend; it has since recovered to near $63,560

Options traders now price in a 48% probability Bitcoin drops to $60,000 by month-end, up from 16% on Friday, with Deribit options traders holding over $800 million in puts (contracts betting the price will fall) at the $60,000 strike

items.title: Goldman Sachs' Expanding Bitcoin Position
points: Q3 2026 disclosure shows Goldman Sachs holds $1.28 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that track bitcoin's price directly rather than through derivatives or futures)
Holdings more than doubled quarter-over-quarter, up 121% from $580 million in Q2
Reflects a broader trend of major financial institutions adding cryptocurrency exposure to their portfolios

items.title: Russia Legalizes Retail Bitcoin Purchases
points: Russia legalized retail bitcoin purchases, opening a major economy to direct cryptocurrency ownership
